set.body: Implement JVM-only atlas asset resolution: cache directory policy, URL download with size/checksum hooks, NIfTI labelmap loading via scalafim.image.io.Nifti, conversion from dense label volumes to VolumeAtlas, and deterministic loader tests with local fixtures. Likely paths: modules/atlas/jvm/src/main/scala/scalafim/atlas/io, modules/atlas/jvm/src/test/scala/scalafim/atlas/io.
set.title: Atlas JVM asset store and NIfTI labelmap loaders
